== Verbatim dest (R-2026-10-23-a) ==
* Verbatim dest of Jerry Fredricks, "The Emperor's Hand", ''InQuest'' #49 (May 1999), pp. 44–47, corrected against opened jp2 page scans [[File:InQuest 49 page 44.jpg]]–[[File:InQuest 49 page 47.jpg]] from archive.org/details/IQ.Gamer.Partial.Collection (inquest.049.-.may.1999.-.classic.6th.edition_jp2.zip; jp2 0025–0028 = printed 44–47).
* Printed spellings kept ("an be deployed"; "wookie-wannabes"; "numero uno;" semicolon; "weird-ass helmet"; "an original victory conditions").
* Splash page 44 is Palpatine still art with the title. Phantom Expansion sidebar on p. 47 dested as cited-page copy (mock •Darth Maul unlinked as a heading; Young Jedi left as a game name).
* Photo credit gutter on p. 45 (Everett Collection / Lucasfilm / Decipher) left off the transcript.
